summary: A big single-seat radial-engined agricultural aeroplane (crop duster / ag plane): a lofted body-of-revolution… joints propeller, wing_aileron_l, wing_aileron_r, hstab_elevator_l, hstab_elevator_r, fin_rudder; sockets socket_pilot.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.crop_duster or place "prefab": "crop_duster" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
